fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Adsorption Cycle (D-A isotherm + LDF kinetics + bed thermal ODEs)
source: Saha, B.B., Boelman, E.C., Kashiwagi, T. (1995) Heat Recovery Systems & CHP 15, 581-590; Saha et al. (1995) Int. J. Refrigeration 18, 254-262; Chua, H.T. et al. (1999) Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 42, 3613-3620; Wang, R.Z., Oliveira, R.G. (2006) Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 32, 424-458.

unit.name: Generic single-stage 2-bed silica-gel / water adsorption chiller

m_sg.note: Mass of silica gel per bed (Saha 1995 prototype scale)

W0.note: D-A maximum adsorption capacity (limiting micropore volume / liq. density). Chua et al. (1999)

D_DA.note: Dubinin-Astakhov coefficient for silica-gel RD / water. Chua et al. (1999) Table 1

n_DA.note: D-A heterogeneity exponent for silica-gel RD / water. Chua et al. (1999)

k_LDF_inf.note: Pre-exponential of LDF coefficient = 15*Dso/Rp^2 with Dso=2.54e-4 m2/s, Rp=0.35 mm (Saha 1995; Chua et al. 1999)

Ea_surf.note: Surface-diffusion activation energy for silica-gel RD. Saha et al. (1995)

dH_ads.note: Isosteric heat of adsorption, silica-gel/water (~2800 kJ/kg). Wang & Oliveira (2006)

h_fg.note: Latent heat of vaporisation of water at ~10 C. NIST / Rogers & Mayhew steam tables

cp_water_vap.note: Water vapour specific heat (~ const). NIST

cp_sg.note: Silica-gel specific heat. Chua et al. (1999)

cp_metal.note: Copper heat-exchanger metal specific heat. NIST

m_metal.note: Bed heat-exchanger metal mass per bed

R_v.note: Specific gas constant of water vapour

UA_bed.note: Bed-to-heat-transfer-fluid conductance (UA) per bed. Chua et al. (1999) scale

m_dot_hw.note: Hot/cooling water mass flow through bed HX

t_half_cycle.note: Half-cycle (switch) time per bed. Saha 1995 optimum ~ 350-450 s
